title: Moki&Julio: Kinect v1 as a measuring instrument (hidden depth lattice, noise populations, capabilities)
description: Measurements and tools for one Xbox 360 Kinect (PrimeSense PS1080) via Kinect for Windows SDK 1.8: the hidden disparity lattice, three per-pixel noise populations, the 2.74 s noise correlation time, warm-up drift, a capability map and a first lateral accuracy check. Every claim has its script and status; corrections are listed first.
